title: 1.5.39 Cause a ReferenceError on Purpose
description: Break it, read the three parts, say which one solved it, then fix it. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Run the broken code
steps.instructions: The file below has a misspelled name. Run it and read the error message that appears.

steps.title: Record the message
steps.instructions: In a comment, write down the error exactly as it appeared.

steps.title: Say which part solved it
steps.instructions: In a comment, say which of the three parts — the kind, the detail, or the place — actually told you what to change, and why.

steps.title: Fix it
steps.instructions: Correct the spelling so the program prints hello.

requirements.title: The misspelling is gone
requirements.description: No use of the misspelled name remains anywhere in the file

requirements.title: The useful part is identified
requirements.description: A comment saying which of the three parts solved it
